designLanguage: Persian tazhib — original vector artwork; public-domain historical references only

rendering.liveText: SwiftUI Text / CoreText — never rasterize original poetry
rendering.chrome: macOS Liquid Glass for controls only; no transparent material over verses

accessiblePadding: ReaderPageLayout manages internal/outer margins at small widths

quality.sourceAttribution: Never erase poet, poem title, or canonical Ganjoor URL
quality.assetUsage: SVGs are editable designer handoff references. SwiftUI Canvas is the native live renderer, not an SVG WebView.
quality.accessibility: Borders and headpieces excluded from VoiceOver, no pointer hit testing. Text remains selectable.
quality.imagery: No user-submitted manuscript scans or commercial fonts redistributed.
